On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.</p> <p>The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.</p> <p>As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.</li> <li>Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.</li> <li>Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.</li> <li>Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.</li> <li>Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.</li> <li>Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.</li> <li>Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.</strong></li> </ul> <h2>Practicals</h2> <ul> <li><strong>You'll report to: </strong>Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions</li> <li><strong>Team: </strong>Lifecycle, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions</li> <li><strong>Location</strong>: EMEA</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Application process</strong></h2> <ol> <li>Interview with recruiter</li> <li>Take Home Exercise</li> <li>Interview with future manager</li> <li>Interview with team members (no managers present)</li> <li>Interview with Senior Manager</li> <li>Bar Raiser</li> <li><a href="https://www.notion.so/Veremark-Remote-96e108c037b8423cbd4c3f07a1f9b38b?pvs=21">Prior employment verification check</a></li> </ol> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Remote's <a href="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/people-Total-Rewards-1945bce8d3924ece9421ba8630f57b0c">Total Rewards philosophy</a> is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair <span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-1691622878">equity</span><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-f2a82bc4-09e4-4a71-ad93-755b1d26a690 notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="3"> pay </span>along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. IT equipment</span></li> </ul> </div> <h2><strong>How you’ll plan your day (and life)</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). title: Automation Engineer - PLC / Plant Control (m/f/d)
description: ABOUT US METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production. And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era. Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer. The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own. We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers. Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future. YOUR MISSION PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary YOUR PROFILE 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen WHY JOIN US? You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment CONTACT Discover more about METYCLE: About us | LinkedIn We look forward to receiving your application. Irene Prinz is happy to answer any questions you may have: +49 152 34 62 72 85. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d) - IMPACT FESTIVAL
description: TechQuartier For 10 years, TechQuartier has been the place in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, where the right people come together through events, programs, and accelerator initiatives to drive innovative growth. As a key driver of innovation in Frankfurt’s financial center, TechQuartier connects FinTech and GreenTech startup founders with established companies in future-shaping fields such as AI, quantum computing, and finance. TechQuartier has been part of the Federal Digital Hub Initiative (de:hub) since its start in 2017. In 2024, TechQuartier was officially recognized as the FinTech Hub Frankfurt within the de:hub network. TechQuartier is also the organizer and host of the IMPACT FESTIVAL in Frankfurt – Germanys largest B2B event for digital & sustainable transformation. TechQuartier continues to advance the startup ecosystem in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main region and strengthens its role as a central innovation hotspot in Europe. If you’re interested in taking on responsibility in a dynamic environment, contributing your own ideas, and driving innovation together with us, you’ve come to the right place. Join our team full-time starting from january 2027 . We look forward to receiving your application. Why this role truly makes an impact The IMPACT FESTIVAL brings together companies, start-ups, investors, and innovators to drive digital and sustainable transformation forward. To make this happen, it takes strong partners and a diverse range of exhibitors. As a (Senior) Sales Manager , you will play a key role in acquiring new exhibitors, sponsors, and partners for the IMPACT FESTIVAL. With your instinct for business opportunities and your strong closing skills, you will directly contribute to the festival’s growth and economic success. This role is not just about managing existing accounts, but about actively creating new opportunities, acquiring a high number of exhibitors, convincing partners, and consistently driving the sales process through to contract signing. What you will drive forward with us You are responsible for selling our exhibitor, trade fair, sponsorship, and partnership offerings, from identifying and approaching potential customers through negotiation to contract signing. You build a sustainable sales pipeline by combining inbound leads with proactive outbound activities to acquire new customers. You develop existing customer relationships, identify cross- and upselling opportunities, and build long-term partnerships. Together with the team, you further develop our sales strategy and pricing structure and identify new market opportunities. You confidently lead negotiations with decision-makers, with a strong focus on closing deals, and develop tailored offers. You ensure a structured handover to the onboarding and account management process and support it as needed. You manage and document your sales activities in our CRM (Pipedrive) and use the data gained to manage, analyze, and optimize the pipeline. You work closely with the IMPACT FESTIVAL team and other relevant departments at TechQuartier, ensuring smooth coordination and collaboration. What you bring to the table You have several years of experience in B2B sales, ideally in the trade fair, conference, event, or sponsorship industry. You have a proven track record in acquiring new customers and experience in successfully driving complex sales processes through to closing. You have a strong understanding of customer needs and market potential and bring experience in developing, implementing, and optimizing sales strategies and pricing structures. You are a strong communicator, approachable, and confident when interacting with a wide range of stakeholders. You communicate fluently in both German and English. You have strong negotiation skills, take initiative, and work in a structured and goal-oriented manner, while keeping track of multiple sales processes running in parallel. You are eager to learn and bring a hands-on mentality and a solution-oriented approach. You are confident working with CRM systems; experience with Pipedrive is a plus. You are passionate about sustainability, digitalization, and innovation. Not required, but definitely helpful You have experience working in a startup or coworking environment and are familiar with the dynamics of agile work cultures. What awaits you with us Team-Spirit: We are an open‑minded, dedicated, and international team that truly embraces innovation and entrepreneurship. To spark new and creative solutions, we value diverse opinions and perspectives. Innovation Hub: You will work in a modern and inspiring environment at the heart of Frankfurt’s start‑up ecosystem. Through constant exchange with start‑ups, you’ll discover new trends and technologies, build valuable connections, and take part in numerous events at TechQuartier. Ownership: From day one, you’ll take responsibility for your own projects, make decisions, and actively shape the future of TechQuartier. Career & Development: We foster a transparent learning and feedback culture. Clear career levels, skill profiles, and plenty of room for your own ideas help you strengthen your talents and grow personally and professionally. Flexibility: With your own laptop and a Deutschlandticket, you’re well equipped. Thanks to the option to work partially remote and flexible working hours within our core time, you can organize your day in the way that makes you most productive. Benefits: 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve, New Year’s Eve, and your birthday; a company pension plan; shopping and fitness discounts; regular team events; and free drinks. We look for potential, not perfect CVs Does the job posting sound exciting to you, but you don’t meet every listed requirement? Please keep in mind that these requirements are just a starting point. We’re looking for people with drive, a willingness to learn, and a desire to take on responsibility. Let’s talk and see if we’re a good fit. Our application process Submit your application via our career portal Initial virtual interview with HR via Microsoft Teams Second interview on-site at TechQuartier with your team lead Final decision & job offer The process may vary slightly depending on your role or the situation—we’ll keep you informed every step of the way. title: Principal Decision Scientist - Marketing
description: We believe it takes great people to create a great product. That’s why our team lives our company values, and we hire based on them, too. Since 2010, Pipedrive has been on a mission to support sales and marketing teams with easy-to-use, powerful tools that make everyday work faster and easier. Today, our cloud-based software is trusted by over 100,000 companies and used in 179 countries. We have grown from a five-person team to a truly international company of over 850+ people, representing more than 50 nationalities, with ten offices distributed across Europe and the US. In 2020, Pipedrive received a majority investment from Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that invests exclusively in enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses, making Pipedrive the fifth unicorn from Estonia. As a Principal Decision Scientist - Marketing, you will lead the development of an analytics function that transforms complex, cross-channel data into strategic insights and measurable business impact. You’ll shape the technical direction for advanced analytics initiatives, driving sophisticated modelling, experimentation, and data infrastructure capabilities that support smarter decision-making across the organization. Operating at the intersection of data science, marketing, and business strategy, you will translate large-scale datasets into actionable recommendations that optimize performance, improve customer outcomes, and support commercial growth. Partnering closely with Marketing, Product, Finance, and Data teams, you will establish scalable measurement frameworks, promote analytical best practices, and influence key business decisions. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working across teams, and turning data into practical business outcomes, we’d love to hear from you! Your new adventure: Lead the design and execution of experimentation frameworks, including geo-based and holdout incrementality testing, to rigorously validate marketing investment decisions at scale Evolve the organisation's Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) capability, including model development, calibration, and translation into actionable budget allocation recommendations for senior leadership Develop sophisticated statistical models such as LTV prediction, churn scoring, and audience segmentation that influence strategic decisions across Marketing, Finance, and Product Architect and govern the marketing data layer, ensuring best practice across dbt modelling, data quality, and documentation Define and lead cross-functional analytics initiatives that span teams and business units, bringing structure and analytical rigour to ambiguous, high-stakes commercial problems Translate highly complex findings into compelling strategic narratives and executive-ready recommendations, enabling data-driven decisions at the leadership level Partner with Finance (FP&A) to ensure marketing efficiency metrics, budget frameworks, and unit economics (CAC, LTV, Payback Period) are consistent with company-wide financial reporting and planning Collaborate with Data Engineering and Marketing Technology to define and shape the long-term marketing data stack roadmap, ensuring tracking integrity, instrumentation standards, and tooling choices reflect best practice Lead the team’s thinking on how AI tools and techniques can augment the analytics workflow, and act as a practical guide for marketing teams on where and how AI can meaningfully improve their ways of working Does this sound like you? 8+ years of experience in a similar role Deep expertise across Acquisition (Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO) and Retention (CRM, Lifecycle, Churn), with the ability to connect channel-level performance to business-wide outcomes Proven, hands-on experience building and deploying Marketing Mix Models (MMM) and incrementality testing frameworks (geo-based, holdout, synthetic control) in a real business context Proficiency in applied statistical modelling, such as LTV modeling, predictive scoring and causal inference techniques Advanced Python or R for statistical analysis, modelling, and automation, with production-quality code standards Practical experience applying AI tools to accelerate, enhance and automate analytical workflows Demonstrated experience architecting scalable data models using SQL and dbt within a modern data stack, including setting standards and reviewing others' work Exceptional ability to distil complex technical findings into clear strategic narratives for non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership Experience working within a high-growth SaaS or digital business with an understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, Payback) Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing analysts including coaching on technical skills, analytical thinking and stakeholder engagement Exposure to product analytics or growth functions, with an ability to connect marketing and product data across the funnel Prior experience influencing tooling, vendor or data infrastructure decisions at an organisational level Why Pipedrive? People-first culture - Be part of a team that values authenticity, champions collaboration, and supports each other—no egos, just teamwork. Work alongside top talent from around the world in an inclusive space where different perspectives fuel our best ideas. Everyone is welcome Unlock potential – Push boundaries, take ownership, and experiment with the latest technologies as we enhance our AI First Vision. We empower bold ideas that drive real change We’ve got you – Your well-being matters. Enjoy flexible hours, wellness perks and SWAG. Think performance-based bonuses, 28 paid leave days, well-being days, compassionate leave, and even paternal leave—because we take care of ourselves and our people Grow with us – Whether through mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility, we invest in helping you unlock your potential. Open, honest feedback and clear communication are at our core. We grow together through trust and accountability Packed with purpose – Help 100,000+ small and medium-sized businesses grow and succeed while doing meaningful, customer-driven work Diversity & Inclusion: Pipedrive is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, marital or family status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Eligibility: Please note that for this position, we are only able to consider candidates who already possess the legal right to work in Germany without the need for visa sponsorship or relocation assistance. Background Checks: Where permitted by local law and necessitated by the scope of the role (e.g., access to sensitive data), Pipedrive may conduct a pre-employment background check. This will be handled in strict accordance with our Candidates Privacy Notice .  #LI-Hybrid #LI-VMUC We’re on the lookout for a strategic, hands-on Principal Decision Scientist - Marketing with deep expertise in marketing analytics, experimentation, and statistical modelling, and a strong ability to turn complex data into clear business recommendations that drive measurable commercial impact. If this is something for you, send us your resume (in English) or a link to your LinkedIn profile and please add why we should pay extra attention to your application. title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)
description: <p>Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m)</strong> at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.</p> <div class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-normal first:pt-0 last:pb-0 py-1 @md:pt-2 @md:pb-[10px] @md:leading-relaxed text-base leading-relaxed text-foreground">Doctolib is becoming an <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">AI-native</strong> company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Senior AI Specialist</strong>, you will be the technical builder and <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">AI Ops Owner</strong> behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams.</div> <div class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-normal first:pt-0 last:pb-0 py-1 @md:pt-2 @md:pb-[10px] @md:leading-relaxed text-base leading-relaxed text-foreground">&nbsp;</div> <div class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-normal first:pt-0 last:pb-0 py-1 @md:pt-2 @md:pb-[10px] @md:leading-relaxed text-base leading-relaxed text-foreground">You will work in <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">founder and product mode</strong>: you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.</div> <h2 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">Your Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Redesign workflows rather than simply automating them:</strong>&nbsp;You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Build and operate AI agents as products:</strong>&nbsp;You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Knowledge and context management:</strong>&nbsp;You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Evaluation and quality assurance:</strong>&nbsp;You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">CRM and data integration:</strong>&nbsp;You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Central interface and enablement:</strong>&nbsp;You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Impact and measurement:</strong>&nbsp;Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.</li> </ul> <h2 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">Your Profile</h2> <p><em>Since production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">potential over years of experience alone</strong>. What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect.</em></p> <h3 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">What Really Matters to Us, Regardless of the Specific Tool:</h3> <ul> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Learning speed and a production mindset:</strong>&nbsp;You have taught yourself a new technical field from scratch and built something real that people actually used. You can describe precisely what went wrong, such as hallucinations, prompt drift, outdated data, or costs, and how you solved it.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">An instinct for evaluation:</strong>&nbsp;You do not rely on something merely “looking good”. You define a quality bar and measure against it. For you, automation and quality go hand in hand.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Ownership and communication:</strong>&nbsp;You take ownership of a problem end to end, prioritize rigorously, feel comfortable with ambiguity, and make technical topics understandable to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Technical and data understanding:</strong>&nbsp;You can read and adapt scripts, understand APIs, webhooks, and automation tools such as Make, n8n, and Zapier, and know how CRM data, ideally Salesforce data, flows into AI systems.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Strong communication skills:</strong>&nbsp;You have a confident command of English and can operate at the highest level in our international environment. German at B1 level is sufficient.</li> </ul> <h3 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">We Are Particularly Interested in:</h3> <ul> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Expertise with agent platforms:</strong>&nbsp;You have practical experience with systems such as Dust, Claude, or LangChain. Since tools evolve quickly, we primarily rely on your process understanding and evaluation skills as a sustainable foundation.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Technical depth and data fluency:</strong>&nbsp;You are proficient in languages such as Python or JavaScript and can confidently navigate title: Enterprise Account Executive - DACH
description: <p><strong>What is an Enterprise Account Executive at Talkdesk…</strong></p> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive at Talkdesk, you will be responsible for pipeline generation across: SDR, Channel Partners, Marketing and Self-generation, targeting entities with 1000+ employees that are aligned to your region.</p> <p>We are looking for a driven, motivated and ambitious Enterprise Account Executives. Someone who will proactively acquire new prospects and drive forward our business offerings through solution based selling. Bring your passion for customer experience and join Talkdesk on our rocketship to success!</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Generate a strong pipeline to ensure extensive coverage. Resulting in consistent quota achievement</li> <li>Create excellent internal relationships; you cannot close those big deals on your own!</li> <li>Manage the complete and complex sales-cycles. Including pipeline generation and often presenting to C-level executives the value of Talkdesk’s solution</li> <li>Streamline the contracts phase; Strong proposal, terms and negotiation experience is important</li> <li>Align with the Talkdesk sales Go-to-Market plan to develop and own accountability for your region’s targeted prospects. Including delivering accurate forecasting and planning to Leadership</li> <li>Build partner, channel, and alliance relationships to to sell more successfully and overachieve your quota</li> <li>Be a Talkdesk Evangelist&nbsp;</li> <li>Work in collaboration with internal resources to own and grow your new business pipeline</li> <li>Work with a base of active customers to upsell new products</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Individuals who enjoy the challenge of Net New Logo’s</li> <li>Proven experience of being able to create self generated opportunities</li> <li>Consistent success selling software into Large Corporate and Enterprise accounts&nbsp;</li> <li>Experienced closing 5-7 figure multi-year contracts</li> <li>Experienced selling to C-suite, senior management and director-level individuals</li> <li>Champion builders and trusted advisors</li> <li>Ability to command the attention in a room by delivering compelling presentations</li> <li>Extensive negotiation and contract development experience</li> <li>Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Talkdesk is pioneering a new era of Customer Experience Automation (CXA), redefining how the world’s most admired brands interact with their customers through AI. Our global team of courageous innovators is customer-obsessed, building AI-first solutions that put empathy, trust, and transparency at the center of every interaction. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive our success and every voice belongs. Combining the stability of a global leader with the agility of a disruptor, Talkdeskers are empowered with the autonomy to drive meaningful impact, while giving back to the communities and environment around us.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Talkdesk has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and in the G2 Overall Grid® Reports for AI Agents and Contact Center. With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation!</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Work Environment and Physical Requirements:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.)</span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400; font-size: 10pt;">The Talkdesk story hinges on empathy and acceptance. It is the shared goal among all Talkdeskers to empower a new kind of customer hero through our innovative software solution, and we firmly believe that the best path to success for our mission is inclusivity, diversity, and genuine acceptance. To that end, we will hire, promote, work along, cheer for, bond with, and warmly welcome into the Talkdesk family all persons without regard to ethnic and racial identity, indigenous heritage, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior/Tech Lead Backend Engineer (Managed Kubernetes)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&amp;D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&amp;D.</p></div><p>Nebius Managed Kubernetes (mk8s) mission is to grow the Nebius cloud platform by providing a Kubernetes-native way to run AI systems with high efficiency and low operational overhead.&nbsp;With a single click, it provides a Kubernetes cluster on top of Nebius services for compute (VMs) and networking.&nbsp;In 2026, the service is scaling 10× and is expected to manage customer workloads across tens of thousands of GPU servers in more than 10 data centers.</p> <p>You will lead the mk8s Core team, one of three mk8s teams. The Core team owns the API, the core of the service control plane, cluster autoscaling, platform integrations, and running k8s add-ons.<br><br>At Nebius, team leads are hands-on. We expect you to be a senior or staff engineer now (or earlier in your career). You will start as an individual contributor to gain context, then take on managerial responsibilities.</p> <h3><strong>In this position, you will be responsible to:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead by example.</strong> Set the quality bar by spending a significant portion of your time on IC work: writing and reviewing code, leading projects, and participating in on-call rotation, incident mitigation, and post-incident analysis.</li> <li><strong>Manage 4–8 mid-to-senior engineers.</strong> Provide context, coach, and give regular feedback.</li> <li><strong>Maintain the technical vision</strong> for your area of responsibility.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with the Product Manager and Service Owner</strong> to shape product vision and plans.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of outcomes you could drive as a Team Lead</h3> <ul> <li>Optimize the service control plane to create and manage 20K GPU nodes in a single Kubernetes cluster, enabling a major contract for the company.</li> <li>Integrate cluster autoscaling approaches (e.g., Karpenter) to improve resource utilization and support seamless auto-upgrades.</li> <li>Provide a Kubernetes-native way to use local disks to reduce disk I/O bottlenecks for AI training and inference, improving efficiency.</li> <li>Deliver managed Layer 7 load balancers to reduce operational overhead for customers.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you will bring to the table:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of professional software engineering or management experience</li> <li>Excellent knowledge of Golang, or you are ready to quickly switch to this programming language</li> <li>Expertise with</li> <ul> <li>Multi-month technical projects</li> <li>Tech leading engineers</li> <li>Owning multi-month technical projects.</li> </ul> </ul> <h3><strong>It would be an added bonus if you had:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with Team management, Kubernetes administration, Developing Kubernetes controller.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving&nbsp;- Bold thinking&nbsp;- Constant growth&nbsp;- Meaningful impact&nbsp;- Trust and real ownership&nbsp;- Opportunity to shape the future of AI&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p>Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.&nbsp;</p> <p>If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer (Stream Processing)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&amp;D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&amp;D.</p></div><h3>The role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the event-processing pipelines and services that turn Nebius product usage into revenue.<br>You will work on systems that process a continuous stream of usage events, where correctness and failure recovery matter as much as throughput. title: Principal, EMEA GTM - Physical AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&amp;D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&amp;D.</p></div><h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role:</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}">Nebius is building the cloud infrastructure that will power the next generation of Physical AI—robotics, autonomous systems, simulation, and embodied intelligence operating in the real world. As a European-headquartered AI infrastructure company, EMEA is a strategic home market for Nebius and one of the most consequential regions in the global Physical AI buildout—from UK autonomy and foundation-model players, to German humanoid and industrial robotics, to Swiss legged-robotics and Israeli/Nordic frontier startups, to the EU's rapidly accelerating defence and dual-use AI ecosystem.</span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}">The Principal, EMEA GTM – Physical AI owns our GTM motion across EMEA: a regional sales overlay role built to drive repeatable revenue within our first and most important segment—Physical AI natives based in or operating across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This is not a generalist regional AE seat. It is a domain-led, EMEA-anchored pipeline generator and deal accelerator designed to create leverage: tighter narratives, sharper use-case framing, and category assets that the EMEA field can run independently.</span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}">You will open strategic, executive-level accounts across the EMEA Physical AI ecosystem, generate qualified pipeline, and personally lead engagement across our EMEA Top 25 target list. On top-tier deals, you will partner directly with EMEA Account Executives, regional sales leadership, and the Physical AI Field CTO team to shape the opportunity early, act as executive sponsor, and accelerate time-to-close. In parallel, you will turn what you learn in-region into repeatable motions—subsegment theses, playbooks, and enablement—tailored to the EMEA buyer, the regulatory environment (EU AI Act, GDPR, data sovereignty), and the region's multi-country go-to-market complexity.</span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}">This is a definitive “zero-to-one” opportunity to build the EMEA commercial foundation for a new cloud category from the ground up, in a region where Nebius has structural home-market advantage. You are welcome to work remotely from within EMEA, with strong preference for London or Munich; Paris or Amsterdam are also viable.</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>EMEA Pipeline Generation &amp; Account Ownership:&nbsp;</strong>Generate qualified, industry-sourced pipeline and open strategic, executive-level accounts within the EMEA Physical AI ecosystem—autonomous vehicles, humanoid and industrial robotics, foundation-model and world-model builders, industrial computer vision, and the OEM/Tier-1 cohort investing in Physical AI in Germany, France, Sweden, and Italy. Personally own engagement for our EMEA Top 25 target list and ensure each account has a clear engagement plan and is actively progressing.</li> <li><strong>Deal Acceleration with the&nbsp;</strong><strong>EMEA Field:&nbsp;</strong>Frame use cases and shape solution direction in the early stages of a deal. Partner directly with EMEA AEs, regional GMs, and the Field CTO on top-tier accounts to accelerate closure, acting as the executive sponsor and regional domain authority. Your involvement is the difference between a stalled deal and a closed one.</li> <li><strong>EMEA Lighthouse Account Execution:&nbsp;</strong>Identify and secure the most innovative companies across EMEA's AI-native Physical AI segments—autonomy, humanoid robotics, foundation/world-model builders, simulation-first startups, defense and dual-use—converting them into flagship customer wins that validate our platform, establish category credibility in-region, and create reference gravity for the rest of EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Subsegment Theses &amp; Category Building (EMEA Lens):</strong> Define EMEA-specific subsegment theses and extract cross-account insights to establish repeatable deal patterns. Identify which European customer profiles convert fastest, which use cases generate the highest consumption, which objections appear most frequently (sovereignty, AI Act compliance, data residency, EU-based support), and which regional GTM motions actually work. Operationalize those learnings into scalable sales plays the EMEA field can run.</li> <li><strong>EMEA Sales Playbook Development:&nbsp;</strong>Codify market learnings into a comprehensive “EMEA Physical AI Playbook.” Develop battle cards, positioning guides, objection-handling frameworks, and competitive intelligence materials specific to the EMEA buyer. Deliver formalized, documented sales motions that the broader EMEA field team—across the UK, DACH, France, Benelux, Nordics, Southern Europe, the Middle East, and Israel—can execute independently.</li> <li><strong>Regional Field Enablement:</strong> Act as a force multiplier for the EMEA sales organization. Run internal enablement sessions and training for EMEA Sales, SAs, and Marketing on Physical AI positioning, target personas, regional regulatory framing (EU AI Act, GDPR, sovereignty), and use-case framing. Publish case studies and reference stories from EMEA lighthouse wins to arm the broader regional team.</li> <li><strong>Revenue Conversion in Region:</strong> Own the long-term revenue trajectory of the Physical AI domain in EMEA, ensuring that early lighthouse technical wins translate into high-volume compute consumption as customers scale their training, simulation, and inference workloads on Nebius infrastructure—and that EMEA contributes its full share of the Physical AI revenue target.</li> <li><strong>E</strong><strong>MEA Market Intelligence &amp; Competitive Positioning:</strong> Maintain a real-time understanding of the EMEA Physical AI competitive landscape. Track where other cloud providers are winning or losing within our target segments. Feed competitive intelligence into sales assets and deal strategy. Position Nebius's European-headquartered, sovereignty-friendly posture as a structural advantage where it matters.</li> <li><strong>Regional Ecosystem Evangelism:</strong> Evangelize our capabilities at EMEA-relevant industry events (e.g., Hannover Messe, Automatica, European Robotics Forum, VivaTech, AI Summit London, Web Summit, Slush, and EMEA editions of ICRA/IROS/CoRL when applicable) and customer executive briefings—positioning Nebius as the infrastructure of choice for Physical AI workloads built and deployed in Europe and across the broader EMEA region.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">We expect you to have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>7+ years </strong>of experience in sales overlay, GTM strategy, or domain-specialist selling within Cloud, AI Infrastructure, or High-Performance Computing—with a meaningful portion of that experience focused on EMEA customers.</li> <li><strong>EMEA Operating Fluency: </strong>Deep familiarity with how to sell across the UK, DACH, France, Benelux, Nordics, Southern Europe, the Middle East, and Israel. You understand that EMEA is not one market and you have a point of view on which subregions to lead with for a category like Physical AI.</li> <li><strong>Proven Pipeline Generation: </strong>Demonstrated track record of personally sourcing and generating qualified pipeline across EMEA through outbound prospecting, industry relationships, and strategic account engagement at the executive level.</li> <li><strong>Deal Acceleration DNA: </strong>Experience partnering with Account Executives across multiple EMEA countries to accelerate complex enterprise and startup deals. You know how to frame a use case, position value, and act as an executive sponsor to drive closure.</li> <li><strong>Sales Playbook Builder: </strong>You have built GTM motions from scratch before—segmenting a market, defining the pitch, creating the sales plays, and training a broader regional team to execute. Bonus if you have done it specifically for EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Deep Domain Fluency: </strong>You speak the language of the builders. You understand the difference between model training, simulation, synthetic data generation, and inference workloads. You know the key players—startups and incumbents—across the modern Physical AI stack, with strong recall of the European cohort specifically.</li> <li><strong>Regulatory &amp; Sovereignty Awareness: </strong>Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR, data-residency expectations, and the sovereign-cloud conversation in Europe. You can speak credibly with customers for whom these are first-order procurement considerations rather than afterthoughts.</li> <li><strong>Enablement Mindset: </strong>You enjoy teaching and scaling knowledge. You can take complex technical wins and distill them into simple, repeatable sales motions for a broader EMEA team that lacks your domain depth.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Orchestration: </strong>Proven track record of working across Sales, SAs, Marketing, and Product Marketing—often across multiple EMEA countries and time zones—to align distinct teams behind a unified GTM execution plan.</li> <li><strong>Startup &amp; AI-Native Fluency: </strong>Experience working with (or selling to) high-growth, venture-backed European startups. You understand the urgency, the technical depth, and the rapid decision-making of this customer base, as well as how European founders and CTOs evaluate infrastructure differently from their US counterparts.</li> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>Strong executive presence and communication skills, capable of holding your own with VC-backed founders, CTOs, and senior technical decision-makers across EMEA. Additional European languages (German, French) are a plus, not a requirement.</li> <li><strong>Comfort in Ambiguity: </strong>Experience operating in fast-moving environments where the sales motion is not yet fully defined and requires real-time iteration and pattern recognition.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Why Nebius:</span></span></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Regional Ownership: </strong>You are not inheriting a quota on an existing product line in an existing region; you are building the EMEA revenue engine for an entirely new category of cloud infrastructure, in our strategic home market.</li> <li><strong>Category Definition: </strong>Define the EMEA playbook that the rest of the company will use to sell Physical AI in the region for years to come.</li> <li><strong>Frontier Technology: </strong>Work at the bleeding edge of embodied intelligence, engaging with the companies defining the future of robotics, autonomy, and the physical world—right at the center of Europe's accelerating AI buildout.</li> <li><strong>Structural Advantage: </strong>Nebius is European-headquartered. Sovereignty, EU data residency, and regulatory alignment are real selling points—not retrofits.</li> <li><strong>High Leverage: </strong>Focus on the top 10% of transformative EMEA customers that drive the next 90% of growth within this segment.</li> <li><strong>Mission: </strong>Help define how intelligence moves from the data center into the physical world—starting from Europe. <span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-GH1</span></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving&nbsp;- Bold thinking&nbsp;- Constant growth&nbsp;- Meaningful impact&nbsp;- Trust and real ownership&nbsp;- Opportunity to shape the future of AI&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. title: Software Engineer, Platform
description: The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.   Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.  Overview The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web. These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice. The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast. What Yo u' ll Do Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going An Ideal Candidate Should Have Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required) Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it A preference for being corrected over being right Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes Interview process Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week. The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it. What We Offer A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain Think you're a good fit for this job?  Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn. Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?  Refer them!  Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.  Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Within this domain, you will build and operate systems across the full securities lifecycle: instruments and market data, orders and trades, portfolios and positions, taxes, clearing and settlements, corporate actions, and reporting. You’ve gained good experience with software in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure) and the architectural patterns for this environment. You have a good understanding of any of these document-based or relational database technology such as MySQL/ PostgreSQL . You know how to write high-quality code that is understandable, maintainable and well tested, and can guide other engineers to do the same via code reviews. You have a track record of designing, building and operating reliable and scalable backend systems as part of a cross-functional team. You will be successful in this role if: Growing investment opportunities excites you. We operate in a highly regulated environment and therefore having worked prior in a Fintech or financial Service provider would give you a head start, but is not a must. You see yourself as a product engineer. That means, you are excited by solving customer problems and strive to become an expert in the domain area you are working in. You enjoy modifying and scaling existing systems. This means high involvement in the product development process itself while advocating for the best engineering practices. It also means that you enjoy taking technical decisions. You are ready and willing to take ownership of problems and act on them decisively with no supervision. You always thrive for high quality outcomes through focus, determination and attention to detail. You are a team player. Working together as a team, sharing knowledge & providing mentorship comes naturally to you. Long term - you consider becoming a team lead. You have no problem with learning new technologies on the go. You try to solve problems with more things than the ones you already know. We will always enable you with that, but your willingness has to come first. You understand what working in a startup or a similar lean organisation is like. You are able to work with a small team in a lean environment, can move quickly and focus on what's truly important. You see yourself reflected in the skills above, or you see yourself growing into this path. We're looking for people with passion, desire to learn and that are team players. You're encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out - and set you apart - especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. How we take care of you: 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets. 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration. 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. title: Senior Java Engineer (m/f/d) - Team Search
description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.   We're looking for a motivated and driven Senior Java Engineer to join our customer-facing Search team in our Demand Division. This team owns the first crucial step in the booking funnel and focuses on providing a fast and intuitive user experience to our customers in 40+ countries worldwide. As a Search team, our goal is to simplify the user experience and provide enough information — without overwhelming the user — to help customers find their perfect trip easily. We achieve this by analyzing anonymous behavior data and conducting regular user research, ensuring we focus on good solutions for real user issues. Looking ahead, we aim to make even greater use of our big data to enhance the user experience with relevant statistics and insights at the right moment in the journey. You'd join an autonomous, cross-functional squad — a Product Owner, backend and frontend engineers, plus data & UX partners and principal engineers who've built this engine at scale. Honest retros, short standups, real ownership from concept to production. We also invite you to be an active contributor to the Engineering Community and challenge the status quo at FlixTech! About the Role Be at the forefront of Flix's booking funnel, handling millions of search requests per day from Web, App, and external partners Generate the inventory to allow customers to reach any place on our network (3,000+ destinations in 40+ countries!) Apply your geekiness: have you ever wondered what to do with graph theory? This is the team for you! Write SOLID, maintainable, flexible, testable, and scalable code Design components and integrations within team scope, considering scalability, maintainability, and reliability Lead adoption of better engineering practices and adapt workflows for team efficiency Prioritise and plan tech debt pay-down with the team; drive strategies to reduce recurring debt Ensure team code is observable and design monitoring strategies for new components Support our CI/CD environment and produce a positive impact with each release Support our agile, flexible, team-oriented development to bring the search product to the next level About You Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Systems, or relevant industry experience 7+ years of commercial experience as a Java Engineer Strong experience with Java/JVM-based frameworks such as Micronaut or Spring Boot Solution-oriented attitude with a focus on materializing the business vision through technical means Experience with k8s and AWS Experience with database management systems such as MySQL or similar relational databases Solid experience with distributed messaging systems (Kafka or others) Nice to Have: Experience with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch Experience with Redis and Terraform Familiarity with CI/CD best practices (unit and integration testing, GitLab CI) Experience working with scalable systems handling large volumes of requests/data We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!   What We Offer Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.  Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.  Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.  Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.  Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.  Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.  To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link:  Locations - Flix Career Why Join Flix? At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!    Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.  We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio. We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience. Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance. Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis. Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension. Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet. Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction. Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.   Your Profile: We're looking for someone with {explicit job content} experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation. 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup. A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit. Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features. Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring. Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them. Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders. A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus. Fluent English required Our hiring process : TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better. Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager. Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews *Some processes might slightly change according to needs Ready to apply? Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster. We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English. *Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role. #LI-PM1 At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.  As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment. Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner. The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
