title: Multiphysics Simulation Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT Alpha will be the first stellarator to achieve net energy. Getting there requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, heating work as one, and work at the edge of what each discipline can deliver on its own. You will own the complex calculations that set the requirements each system needs to be designed against. You will be accountable for providing the engineering design teams with reasonably estimated and correctly validated load cases that drive the design of the machine. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own simulation pipelines end to end. From physics assumptions through to the machine-defining load cases you provide the subsystem to teams. You own the whole chain, not a step in it. Build the simulators . Finite-element models where that's the right instrument, a reduced-order model coded from scratch where it isn't, all of it properly interfaced with our codebase. Set the interfaces. Define with each engineering team what goes in, what comes out, what it means and what it doesn't cover. Scan the space . Run parameter sweeps and simulation campaigns at scale to settle machine-level tradeoffs before they're locked in. Prove the numbers . Benchmark, cross-check against analytical limits and experiment, and know the boundary where your model stops being trustworthy. WHO YOU ARE You range across physics and geometry. You are not afraid of jumping between Lorentz forces in a stellarator and the 3D geometry. You've earned that breadth. A PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and time spent where multiphysics analysis actually drives hardware decisions: space, accelerators, semiconductors, aircraft, or anywhere else complex machines get built at scale. You build in code like an engineer, not a scripter. Git, CI/CD, and the PyData stack are second nature, and you've shipped real software, not a folder of one-off scripts. You reach for whatever tool fits . Pen and paper, a solver you wrote last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse. You think in pipelines. Automation, reproducibility, validation. And you can tell when a passing series of tests isn't actually telling the truth. You're proactive . You find the gap before it becomes a problem, prioritize hard, and argue for the next step. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) *This role sits at PF3 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information. At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. description: Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Partner with the Country Execution Lead to drive cross-functional collaboration, ensuring our pipeline consistently delivers high-potential locations on schedule. Champion a world-class customer experience by collaborating with Local Operations to maintain pristine, high-uptime stations that exceed charging performance standards. Oversee day-to-day operations with a focus on agility, continuously refining workflows to maintain momentum and operational excellence. Collaborate with legal teams to ensure regulatory compliance and risk mitigation. Strong commercial background and expertise across B2B and B2C markets. Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and inspire teams. Passion for sustainability and the transition to electric mobility.   What’s in it for you? title: Product Manager (parental leave cover)
description: About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. The benefits Passion for languages: We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. Take a deep dive: As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. Teams who train together, stay together: We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. It takes a team to Tandem: Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. Balance matters: Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. Modern family: As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. Relocation without the stress: If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. title: Game Data Analyst (f/m/d)
description: We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. Game Data Analyst (f/m/d) Are you curious about what makes games engaging? Do you enjoy understanding not just what players do, but why they do it, and turning that understanding into clear, actionable insights? We are looking for a Game Data Analyst to strengthen our product analytics capabilities. In this role, you will combine strong analytical thinking with solid technical foundations to support multiple game teams over time.  This is an individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on data modeling, advanced analysis, and scalable analytical foundations. Responsibilities Partner with product and game teams to answer complex questions around player behavior, engagement, and progression Perform advanced analyses using SQL to uncover patterns and drivers behind player actions Design and analyze player segmentation and behavioral cohorts Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests to measure feature performance, optimize player experiences, and guide data-informed decisions. Build and maintain reliable, analytics-ready data models (experience with dbt or similar tools) Ensure data quality, clarity, and documentation of key datasets and metrics Contribute to self-serve reporting and visualization Partner with cross-functional teams to align priorities, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure analytics is central to shaping the player experience. Collaborate with other analysts and data infrastructure team to improve analytical workflows and standards Required Skills 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools Experience working with complex datasets and analytical data models Ability to translate data into clear insights for both technical and non-technical audiences Curiosity, ownership, and eagerness to learn new tools and approaches Desirable Skills Experience with Looker and dbt Experience with Python or R for data analysis. Familiarity with data orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow) Background in games, free-to-play, or product analytics Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability. We are an international studio, so don’t forget to send in your application in English. Although it is not mandatory, we always appreciate a cover letter stating your motivation to join us. We look forward to hearing from you! Your Benefits – We’re game to support you Competitive Salary  - We believe that top performers should receive top payment Learning Budget  - We believe in learning. A generous personal learning budget to spend on learning and development, including books, workshops and attending conferences. We also offer in-house training such as coding and German classes Flexible Working Hours and Home Office  – We believe in a good work-life balance Equipment  - State-of-the-art technical equipment, including laptops and phones, which may also be used in your free time Health and Fitness  - We pay a contribution towards a monthly gym membership or a fitness activity Relocation  - Relocation support to help you move to Berlin Pension  - Opportunity to save for your pension tax-free Bonus Level – We love to have a good time, too Food and Drinks  - Fresh fruits to keep you healthy and fresh coffee to keep you alert. We also have a fully stocked fridge with Smoothies, Coke, Club Mate, beer etc Parties and Team Events  - Apart from our regular parties, BBQs and movie nights we also have a team event budget you can use to buy games or sports equipment to make working here even more fun Company Holidays  - Every year we go on an amazing company holiday to relax and bond as a team Friday Celebrations  - Company-provided dinner and drinks on Friday afternoons Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️ Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in! We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️ Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. Why RoomPriceGenie? We take both culture and product seriously: recognized as Best Place to Work in HotelTech (2026) and Best Revenue Management Software (2026) . We power pricing for thousands of hotels worldwide on a modern data stack. This is a fully remote role within Europe (UTC+0 to UTC+2) . You will have genuine ownership, strong support, and the opportunity to build high-value internal AI systems and agents that make our operational teams significantly faster and smarter. Your Role As an AI Systems & Automation Engineer , you will drive internal AI adoption across Customer Success, Sales, and Operations. Your job isn't to build raw ML models or write throwaway demos. You will work directly with business leads to unblock legacy processes, connect internal data to core operational tools, and deploy dependable, supervised AI agents that automate complex workflows. You will join our AI & Security team and bridge the gap between our core data platforms (Snowflake, Postgres, DocumentDB, S3) and our GTM stack (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo, Notion), establishing practical patterns for safe, agentic automation across the business. What You’ll Do Translate Business Pain into Systems: Partner directly with Customer Success, Sales, and Ops teams to map out manual, multi-step workflows and design high-ROI AI automation targets. Build Production Agents & Integrations: Write clean, maintainable code (Python/TypeScript) connecting LLM APIs to internal data stores and third-party SaaS platforms (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo, Notion). Implement Modern Agent Standards: Build modular agent capabilities using standardized tools and schemas (such as Agent Skills standards, Claude Plugins, or custom function-calling pipelines) to give models safe, structured action boundaries. Design Human-in-the-Loop Workflows: Implement strict guardrails, schema validation, human approval gates, and escalation paths so non-technical staff can safely supervise AI outputs. Ensure Integration Reliability: Manage API rate limits, Webhooks, asynchronous jobs, and retry logic to keep integrations rock-solid as internal data volume grows. Measure & Iterate: Build lightweight evaluation harnesses to track agent accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost, optimizing prompt architectures and model choices based on real production usage. Your Profile Strong Software Fundamentals: Solid background in Python and/or TypeScript, asynchronous execution, REST APIs, Webhooks, SQL, and working with relational or analytical databases. Claude & LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Deep, hands-on proficiency with Claude (Anthropic API, Prompt Engineering, Workbench, SDKs) and adjacent modern developer applications. Agent Skill & Tool Design: Familiarity with modern agent capability frameworks, such as standard Agent Skills ( agentskills.io ), Claude Plugins / Model Context Protocol (MCP), or structured tool execution design. Integration & Ecosystem Familiarity: Experience consuming complex SaaS APIs (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo). Proficiency with Notion (APIs, workspace structures, and knowledge management) is a strong plus. Operational Empathy: Business-minded engineer who enjoys talking to non-technical colleagues, understanding messy legacy processes, and building practical tools that make their daily jobs easier. Location & Communication: Fluent in English and based in European time zones (UTC+0 to UTC+2). We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍 Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free. Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps ! As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox. Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence. Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity. Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions. An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings. A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion. A desire to work with and lead individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production. Nice to Have Traits for This Role Proficiency in C++ What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. title: Software Engineer, Backend - Core/API & Process Automation
description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: Backend engineering rarely gets this consequential. As a Software Engineer on Camunda's Core / API & Process Automation team, you'll work on the beating heart of Camunda 8 — the event-sourced, distributed workflow engine that executes business-critical processes for thousands of customers and, through them, millions of people worldwide. Because you sit at the core, one well-made improvement propagates outward through every integration and product built on top of it: a small change here is felt everywhere. Few systems demand this. You'll dig into the performance of the hot paths, into versioning strategies for an engine that must faithfully replay every event it has ever written — forever, and into the concurrency between the engine advancing a process and a user mutating that same process in the same instant. And the bar is unforgiving: data must never be corrupted, and a process must never get stuck — because when it does, customers lose money. This is genuine distributed-systems work — event sourcing, ordering, concurrency, replay — not another CRUD app. You'll also help build what comes next — including enabling AI agents to drive the engine, cutting-edge work that stretches what the industry thinks automation can do. You'll do it alongside a world-spanning team of highly skilled, highly motivated engineers who share one goal: make Camunda the best workflow engine in the world. And this is where you grow fast: you'll own well-scoped work end-to-end, deliberately take on unfamiliar and uncomfortable problems to stretch yourself, and learn from senior engineers you work beside every day — with everything shipping in the open (Zeebe is open source). Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale What You’ll Be Doing: Build and evolve features in the event-sourced engine and its C8 REST/gRPC/MCP API (command/event, CQRS), with guidance on the harder design calls. Own well-scoped work end-to-end — implement, test, and ship; contribute your ideas to solution designs and write clear design notes / ADRs. Help ship high-impact engine features — like suspending and resuming individual process instances, enabling AI agents to steer running processes, and variable tracing — and watch them reach thousands of customers. Design and consume clean APIs — good contracts, developer ergonomics, and an awareness of not breaking existing integrations. Detect and optimize inefficient processing and data-access patterns across our data stores (RocksDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, relational/Postgres) — growing into the harder cases — and build observability into what you ship. Proactively flag issues and tech debt , keep quality high through reviews and testing (collaborative, not a lone hero), and participate in support / on-call as you ramp. Must Haves: Ability and/or willingness to use our product 2+ years professional backend engineering experience. Solid grasp of event-driven systems and genuine eagerness to go deep on event sourcing / distributed systems — including a working understanding of consistency, ordering, and failure basics. Good API design instincts (REST) — clean, sensible contracts, with awareness of backward compatibility. Product thinking — you care about the outcome for users, not just the ticket. Strong "manager of one" — own your work and drive it forward without day-to-day management, manage your own time and focus in a remote/async setting, communicate progress and raise blockers early (self-directed, but knows when to ask for help), and reliably follow through on what you commit to. High growth drive — genuinely ambitious to level up, and actively takes on unfamiliar, uncomfortable challenges rather than staying in the comfort zone. Clear written communication in a remote-first, async setting. Nice-to-haves: Experience with workflow automation / process orchestration (BPMN or similar). Comfort reasoning about query patterns in Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and relational/Postgres. Familiarity with observability (logging, metrics, tracing). Working JVM knowledge. In this hands-on role, you will help establish and maintain our CAD standard part library, provide first-level support to engineering users, and contribute to the documentation of CAD and PLM processes. Your primary focus will be supporting the creation and continuous improvement of a standard part library for CAD users. You will also act as a first point of contact for basic user requests and help create clear, practical documentation that enables our engineering teams to work effectively in a fast-paced aerospace environment. This is an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in CAD data management, PLM administration, engineering processes, and technical support while contributing to the development of a real space vehicle. Key responsibilities CAD and PLM administration Support the creation, organisation, and maintenance of structured CAD and PLM data. Support the setup and maintenance of CAD templates, standard part libraries, drafting standards, preferences, and other engineering environment settings. Work with engineers and designers to identify opportunities to improve CAD workflows, data quality, reuse, and user experience. Assist with testing and documenting changes to CAD and PLM processes, configurations, and system settings. Gain hands-on experience with Siemens NX administration, including configuration concepts, customer defaults, role-based settings, templates, and environment configuration. Learn about Siemens NX customization and automation possibilities under the guidance of experienced team members, for example through journals, reusable tools, interface settings, or workflow improvements. Contribute to guidelines and best practices for CAD and PLM usage, including the appropriate use of standard parts and reusable engineering content. Documentation and process support Create and maintain user guides, how-to instructions, process descriptions, and FAQs. Document CAD and PLM procedures in a clear and accessible way. Support the preparation of training material for new and existing users. General CAD and PLM administration and support Assist with routine administration and monitoring tasks in the CAD and PLM environment under supervision. Support users and create documentation based on frequent support requests Work with engineering, PLM, CAD, and IT colleagues to improve data quality and user experience. Good communication skills in English. Basic experience with Siemens NX and strong interest in CAD, engineering data management, PLM, or technical systems administration. Organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with structured data and technical information. A proactive, hands-on attitude and willingness to learn. Comfortable working collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team. Nice to have Basic familiarity with PLM concepts or systems such as Siemens Teamcenter. Experience with C# and .Net, Powershell Basic understanding of engineering drawing standards, part numbering, metadata, or configuration management. title: Founding Solutions Architect
description: About Zelara Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way. Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome. With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift , measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. Now we are hiring our first Solutions Architect to make the path from integration to measurable value repeatable. The Role This is a deeply technical customer role centered on post-sales value realization, with involvement in pre-sales discovery. It is not conventional customer success built around reactive support and business reviews, nor a pre-sales role that hands off at signature. You will own technical value realization for a portfolio of customers, from discovery and onboarding through live experiments, measured results, and scaled adoption. You and the commercial lead run each account as a pair, in a weekly rhythm and in the room together for the conversations that decide something. They own pricing, proposals, contracts, conversion to an annual contract, expansion, and renewal. You own the technical plan and evidence behind those decisions. Before signature, you lead technical discovery alongside them. After signature, you become the customer's named technical lead, accountable for solution design, data mapping, the experiment plan, stakeholder coordination, and go-live. You make value real and defensible; the commercial lead owns the close. There is no separate customer success manager, and we are not planning one. The two of you hold the whole relationship: the commercial lead is the account owner, you are the technical owner, and the working relationship with the customer's CRM, data, and analytics teams is yours. Your focus is the customer-specific application of Zelara's platform. Product owns the roadmap and prioritization. Engineering owns production software, reusable integrations, reliability, and security. Science owns the learning methods and models, experimental methodology, and causal measurement standards. You turn their work into a functioning customer solution and bring in each team when a requirement crosses those boundaries. Today our founders lead the technical side of every customer relationship. You will take over that responsibility and build the function as the customer base grows. You will work with mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits. Successful pilots grow into long-term, scaled deployments. What You Will Do Own the technical customer journey from discovery through onboarding, pilot delivery, measured value, and scaled adoption Lead technical discovery before signature: understand how the customer makes money and which metric moves it, then validate the integration path, available data, measurement feasibility, and what the pilot can credibly promise Own onboarding: align stakeholders, define the data mapping and acceptance criteria, coordinate implementation, and take the customer live on its existing CRM stack Design and pre-register each customer experiment using Zelara's scientific standards: hypothesis, primary metric, cohort, control group, conversion window, success threshold, and decision rules, because a success bar set after seeing the data is not a result Own the customer-facing interpretation of results: reconcile Zelara's analysis with the customer's data, involve Science in novel or ambiguous analyses, and state clearly when the evidence is not decision-ready Enable the customer's team to operate campaigns independently rather than becoming the person who runs them Partner with the commercial lead on annual contracts, expansion, and renewal: identify the opportunity, quantify the value, and de-risk the technical plan Drive the product loop rather than report into it: turn recurring customer needs into product opportunities, engineering requirements, and research questions, and bring the evidence from live accounts that decides their priority Build what closes the gap in the meantime: use agents to produce the scripts, tooling, and prototypes that unblock an account before the platform covers it Your First 90 Days 30 Days (Immersion): Learn the platform and customer portfolio, join every active account, and take ownership of your first technical customer relationship. 60 Days (Ownership): Lead one onboarding independently, with the integration requirements, campaign configuration, experiment design, and measurement plan agreed before launch. 90 Days (Scale): Own a small portfolio, deliver your first evidence-backed results readout, use it with the commercial lead to inform an annual-contract or expansion decision, and improve the playbook based on live accounts. Who You Are You have led deployments, implementations, or technical accounts for mid-market or enterprise customers at a B2B SaaS company, and your work has influenced adoption, renewal, or expansion. You judge a customer's business before you design for it: which metric their leadership is measured on, which one is decoration, and what matters that nobody has said out loud. You aim the solution at the first. You can turn a business question into an analysis plan: define the right metric, cohort, and measurement window; identify what would disprove the claim; and judge whether the evidence is decision-ready. You have led real customer integrations and know that a successful import is not the same as usable data. You understand experiments: control groups, effect sizes, statistical power, conversion windows, and why the design has to be frozen before it runs. You know the lifecycle marketing stack (Braze, Bird, Iterable, Klaviyo, Customer.io , Emarsys, HubSpot): what it does well, where it stops, and how a CRM team works inside it. You are credible with a Head of CRM and their data engineer in the same hour, and you switch between them without losing either. You say the uncomfortable thing early, and a commitment with a date on it is a commitment. You want to build the function, not only perform the role. You are AI-native in how you work. A software engineering background is not a requirement. Building with agents is: the script that reshapes a customer's export, the prototype that shows a CRM team what we mean, the tooling that saves you the next ten hours. You are fluent in English. German is a strong advantage given our current market focus. Bonus You have been the operator on the other side, running lifecycle or CRM programs in-house, so you know what we are asking a customer's team to change. You have experience with experimentation platforms, bandits, or applied ML in production. You have converted pilots or POCs into multi-year contracts and can say what actually moved the decision. How We Work We are an AI-first team. We use spec-driven workflows and AI-assisted execution across engineering and go-to-market, adopting what makes us faster and discarding what does not. We value evidence, speed, and clear ownership over process theater, status reporting, or activity for its own sake. If you want to push the boundaries of how software gets delivered to customers, not just what gets delivered, you will fit right in. What We Offer Work alongside founders who have built and sold an AI-driven SaaS business and led large-scale B2C operations from the customer's side of the table. A founding senior individual-contributor role in Solutions Architecture. You define the playbook now, with a path to build and lead the function as the customer base grows. Autonomy over onboarding, pilots, and technical value realization, with close partnership on account growth and a tight working relationship with Product, Science, and Engineering. Direct access to real customers and real production data. Based in Berlin with regular travel to European customers. A competitive salary and a meaningful equity stake, early enough to shape the company's direction. Your choice of a Deutschlandticket or bike subscription, plus a gym/fitness club membership. Our Compass We are guided by four core values: Seek Truth: We ground decisions in evidence. When the facts change, we change our mind. Act with Integrity: We build trust through transparency, reliability, and ownership. Put Customers First: We succeed only when they succeed. Accelerate Impact: We prefer speed, simplicity, and real learning over ceremony. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) for telemedicine platform
description: Your role at Ocumeda As Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) you are the engineer who makes hard, unclear or broken things tractable. You know how our platform works end to end and you shape it as you go. Your focus is our full-stack platform: the web application our doctors, our optician partners, and their customers use daily, and the services behind it. This is an individual contributor role. No direct reports, real technical authority: you set direction on architecture and engineering practice, and you build in the same codebase as everyone else in the team. Staff/Senior here means deeper, not further from the code. Your job is to keep our systems fast to iterate, reliable in production, and ready for international expansion and scaling. Own the architecture of our full-stack platform – frontend, backend, data, AWS – and evolve it under real product pressure instead of rewriting it Own our testing strategy: where we invest in unit, integration and end-to-end coverage, what we deliberately do not test, and how tests stay fast enough that nobody skips them Push our agentic coding practice forward: tooling, guardrails and testing discipline that make us faster without putting unverified code into a live product Shape scope together with product: surface the cheap 80 % solution, and say clearly when something is not worth building Build so that what ships is operable and auditable by design (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 13485), without turning engineering into paperwork Go wherever the problem is – a scaling bottleneck one week, a broken integration the next – you fix it properly What makes you a great fit Several years of professional software engineering experience (roughly 7+), most of it on systems that reached real users Deeply hands-on across the stack: strong in the frontend, at home in the backend, comfortable in the infrastructure and web technologies around it A strong background in TypeScript, and well-formed opinions you can defend and revise A clear product focus: you care about what ships, what runs, and what users experience You speak fluent English (C1); German is a plus ... and as a nice to have: Experience in a start-up or scale-up where speed and quality both mattered Comfort taking ownership and shaping processes nobody has defined yet A degree in a STEM field – equivalent practical experience counts more Exposure to regulated software, medical devices or health data If you match most of this, apply. title: Product Owner (all genders)
description: Deine Rolle bei uns Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung. In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte. Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert. Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen. Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen. Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung. Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick. Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden. Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, hinterfragst und strukturierst sie und stimmst sie mit den relevanten Beteiligten ab. Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen und führst Entscheidungen herbei. Du begleitest Veränderungen und unterstützt dabei, neue Prozesse und Lösungen erfolgreich in der Organisation zu verankern. Beraten & Wissen vermitteln Du unterstützt bei der Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter digitaler Lösungen und Technologien. Du begleitest bei Bedarf Ausschreibungen, Angebotsbewertungen und Beschaffungsprozesse. Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf und unterstützt Anwender durch Workshops, Schulungen und geeignete Materialien. Was du mitbringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in digitalen Projekten, IT-Projekten, Produktentwicklung oder vergleichbaren Rollen mit eigener Verantwortung. Ein gutes Verständnis für Nutzer, Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge. Die Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu strukturieren und Entscheidungen herbeizuführen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mindestens C1). Hohe Reisebereitschaft (50% Anwesenheit am Standort Würzburg). Warum du bei uns richtig bist Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die nicht nur visionär klingen, sondern die Bauwelt tatsächlich smarter und zukunftsfähig machen – und das Ganze in Projekten und mit Kund:innen, die garantiert nicht langweilig werden. Dabei bist du von Anfang bis Ende mitten im Geschehen und hast ein Team an deiner Seite , das fachlich top ist, menschlich der Knaller und jeden Partybus das Fürchten lehrt. Wir glauben an Flexibilität statt Stechuhr, an Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und an stabile Verhältnisse. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem familienfreundlichen Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheidungen. Außerdem warten Team‑Get‑Aways, gemeinsame Events, Hansefit , ein dickes Benefits‑Paket und eine vernünftige Altersvorsorge auf dich. Wir bringen Kompetenz, Verantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und Humor perfekt unter einen Helm bringt.. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Gute Seele / HR-Manager (m/w/d) in Teilzeit
description: Als „Gute Seele“ / HR-Manager (m/w/d) hast Du in einem kreativen und innovativem Arbeitsumfeld die Verantwortung für das wichtigste überhaupt – deine Kollegen. Du kannst beim Wachstum einer sehr jungen, mittelständischen Firma deine Ideen und Vorstellungen von Personalwesen einbringen und die Kultur unseres Miteinander damit zentral gestalten. Aufgaben Du stehst für das Wohl aller Mitarbeiter ein, und nimmst die Rolle unseres „Feel Good Managers“ wahr. Dabei kümmerst Du Dich um vielfältige Aufgaben, angefangen bei kleinen Geburtstags- und Jubiläumspräsenten, über Mitarbeiter-Goodies wie Förderungen von Fitnessmöglichkeiten und weiteren Themen rund um die Gesundheit und das Wohlergehen unserer Mitarbeiter Der bist im kontinuierlichen Austausch mit allen Mitarbeitern, um die Bedürfnisse aller zu verstehen, da das gemeinsame Miteinander für uns elementar ist: Du vertrittst dabei nicht die Geschäftsführung, sondern alle Kollegen. Du betreust alle Mitarbeiter in persönlichen Gesprächen und agierst als Coach um unseren Kollegen zu helfen und unseren Kollegen ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima zu ermöglichen Du suchst nach neuen Mitarbeitern zum Beispiel über indeed und JOIN, wenn wir weiter wachsen – gerne darfst Du auch andere, kreative Ansätze für die Gewinnung von Mitarbeitern bei uns ausprobieren Durch deine Aktivitäten erhöhst Du kontinuierlich die Attraktivität der iconCXM als Arbeitgeber Du kümmerst Dich genauso gewissenhaft um die formalen Angelegenheiten wie die Verwaltung der Personalakten, die Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Personalgesprächen sowie Themen der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge Du organisierst zusammen mit unserer Office- & Travel-Managerin unsere quartalsweisen Vor-Ort-Veranstaltungen inkl. Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerfesten, Team-Building-Events, aber auch weiteren Informations-Runden für alle Mitarbeiter Qualifikation Du lebst das „Mensch sein“ (du bist offen, transparent, ehrlich, vertrauenswürdig, tolerant, respektvoll, kommunikativ, loyal … eine gute Seele) Du bist eigenständig, kannst Themen auch alleine umsetzen Du hast Erfahrung im Coaching von Menschen und einen Background im Personalwesen Du lernst gerne Neues Benefits Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag + krisensicherer Arbeitsplatz und -lohn 30 Tage Urlaub - der 24.12. und 31.12. sind ebenfalls arbeitsfreie Tage Gute Work-Life-Balance - Du legst Deine wöchentliche Arbeitszeit selbst fest Home-Office-Möglichkeiten Nagelneues Büro im Herzen von Stuttgart mit moderer und ergonomischer Ausstattung, welches Du mitgestalten darfst Kleines, herzliches und humorvolles Team, wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima, transparente Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe und kurze Entscheidungswege Regelmäßige Team Events Zugang zu zahlreichen Weiterbildungsangeboten Auswahl an verschiedenen Benefits (Sportzuschüsse, Jobticket, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, etc.) Wir haben keine Kleiderordnung - Du darfst ganz Du selbst sein Du findest Dich in der Beschreibung wieder? title: Sales Development Manager B2B (m/w/d)
description: Standort: Forchheim | Vollzeit Du sorgst dafür, dass aus einem guten Anlass ein gutes Gespräch wird. VIAMA übernimmt für Unternehmen den laufenden Betrieb von Informationssicherheit und Governance. Unsere Kunden müssen Anforderungen wie NIS2, ISO 27001 oder TISAX nicht nur einmal umsetzen. Sie müssen sie dauerhaft betreiben. Unser Vertrieb funktioniert deshalb etwas anders. Wir kaufen keine beliebigen Leadlisten und erwarten von dir auch keine hundert wahllosen Kaltanrufe am Tag. Wir identifizieren gezielt Unternehmen, bei denen konkrete Signale auf einen möglichen Bedarf hinweisen. Zum Beispiel eine offene Informationssicherheitsrolle, eine laufende NIS2 Umsetzung oder andere Veränderungen im Unternehmen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, aus diesen Signalen echte Gespräche zu machen. Was du bei uns machst Du übernimmst die operative Ansprache ausgewählter Unternehmen und begleitest einen Account so lange, bis klar ist, ob ein relevantes Thema für VIAMA besteht. Dazu gehört insbesondere: Du recherchierst die richtigen Ansprechpartner in unseren Zielunternehmen. Du nimmst telefonisch Kontakt auf, auch über Zentralen und Assistenzbereiche. Du führst erste Gespräche mit Geschäftsführern, IT-Verantwortlichen und Verantwortlichen für Informationssicherheit. Du findest heraus, wo das Unternehmen bei Themen wie NIS2, ISO 27001 oder TISAX tatsächlich steht. Du erkennst, ob ein konkreter Bedarf besteht und wann der richtige Zeitpunkt für ein weiteres Gespräch ist. Du hältst Wiedervorlagen konsequent nach und lässt interessante Accounts nicht einfach verschwinden. Du dokumentierst die wesentlichen Erkenntnisse sauber im CRM. Sobald ein fachlich relevantes Gespräch entsteht, übergibst du an unseren Geschäftsführer oder einen unserer Governance-Experten. Gemeinsam mit uns entwickelst du anhand echter Gespräche unsere Ansprache und unseren Vertriebsprozess weiter. Du musst dabei keine komplexen Governance-Leistungen am Telefon verkaufen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, die richtige Person zu erreichen, die Situation zu verstehen und einen sinnvollen nächsten Schritt herzustellen. Was wir nicht suchen Wir suchen niemanden, der einfach möglichst viele Telefonnummern abarbeitet. Wir suchen auch keinen klassischen Closer, der mit vorgefertigten Verkaufsskripten Druck erzeugt. Unsere Zielgruppe besteht überwiegend aus Geschäftsführern und erfahrenen Fachverantwortlichen. Entsprechend wichtig ist uns eine Ansprache auf Augenhöhe. Ein klares Nein ist für uns ein gutes Ergebnis, wenn wir anschließend wissen, warum ein Unternehmen nicht zu uns passt. Was du mitbringen solltest Du solltest gerne telefonieren und keine Scheu davor haben, Menschen anzusprechen, die dich noch nicht kennen. Wichtig sind uns außerdem: sehr gutes Deutsch und eine klare, professionelle Ausdrucksweise Hartnäckigkeit, ohne aufdringlich zu werden echtes Interesse daran, Unternehmen und ihre Situation zu verstehen die Fähigkeit, gute Fragen zu stellen und zuzuhören Selbstständigkeit und konsequentes Nachhalten strukturierte Arbeit mit CRM und Wiedervorlagen ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Geschäftsführung und Management Neugier auf Informationssicherheit, Compliance und Unternehmensführung Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Sales Development, Account Development oder telefonischen Geschäftskundenvertrieb ist hilfreich. Erfahrung mit NIS2, ISO 27001 oder TISAX ist keine Voraussetzung. Das fachliche Wissen vermitteln wir dir. Was dich bei VIAMA erwartet Du startest nicht mit einer leeren Excel-Liste. Wir bauen aktuell ein signalbasiertes Vertriebssystem, das relevante Unternehmen identifiziert und den Kontext für die Ansprache vorbereitet. Du bekommst damit nicht nur einen Firmennamen, sondern möglichst auch den Grund, warum ein Gespräch gerade sinnvoll sein könnte. Unser Ziel ist nicht maximale Aktivität. Unser Ziel sind wenige, aber qualifizierte Gespräche mit Unternehmen, bei denen wir tatsächlich helfen können. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Geschäftsführer und unserem Governance-Team zusammen. Was wir aus den Gesprächen lernen, fließt unmittelbar in unseren Vertriebsprozess ein. VIAMA ist ein kleines, wachsendes Unternehmen. Das bedeutet kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und gleichzeitig die Erwartung, Verantwortung für den eigenen Bereich zu übernehmen. Über VIAMA VIAMA Leadership GmbH unterstützt mittelständische und größere Unternehmen beim Aufbau und vor allem beim dauerhaften Betrieb ihrer Governance. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt auf Informationssicherheit und regulatorischen Anforderungen wie NIS2, ISO 27001 und TISAX. Unser Ansatz: Technologie für das Wiederkehrende. Menschen für das Urteil. Wir wollen Governance nicht komplizierter machen, sondern Unternehmen die operative Last abnehmen, die nach Projekten, Audits und Zertifizierungen dauerhaft bestehen bleibt. Klingt nach dir? Dann möchten wir vor allem wissen, wie du mit Menschen ins Gespräch kommst. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, warum diese Art von B2B-Vertrieb zu dir passt. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. VIAMA Leadership GmbH Forchheim Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Sales
description: Thor's Haven | No mission should fail for lack of infrastructure | Munich Thor's Haven keeps critical infrastructure running wherever it's needed most, proven in the hardest conditions there are. Now we are expanding into Europe and hiring the person to lead it. Tasks The role As Head of Sales, you lead Thor's Haven commercial operations in Europe. You carry the European pipeline and the revenue number, and you shape where we sell: which countries, which channels, which accounts. The routes are direct sales, prime and integrator partnerships, and bilateral and humanitarian procurement. Production and certification stay with the team, so your focus stays on customers and contracts. This is the first commercial hire in Europe with no direct reports at the start. Thor's Haven is part of Bifrost Defence. Its military relationships, go-to-market, procurement, and finance sit behind you. What the job involves Build and close the European pipeline, from first conversation to signed contract. Own the European revenue target, forecast it honestly, and deliver it. Build the commercial plan: priority countries, channels, pricing, and key accounts. Lead accounts and deals end to end, including proposals, tenders, pricing, and negotiation. Represent Thor's Haven to military and government buyers, at exhibitions and across the table. Keep the commercial engine disciplined: CRM, sales materials, and honest reporting. Carry what customers and operators tell you back into the product. Requirements **What we are looking for ** This is a hands-on, mid-career role. Needed: Four to eight years in commercial, business development, sales, or investment. Experience with long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals for institutional buyers: government, defence, large enterprise, or institutional capital. Readiness to carry a revenue target and take deals to signature. The self-sufficiency to run a commercial function alone: your own deck, your own meetings, your own proposals. The presence to hold a room with senior buyers and a steady hand in a negotiation. Willingness to travel, Ukraine included. Comfort making the call with incomplete information. Fluent English and the right to work in the EU. Preferred: A background in defence, aerospace, or an adjacent regulated industry. A network in European defence or government procurement. Experience selling hardware or capital equipment, not only software. Experience building a commercial function from the start. Experience with prime or integrator channels. Benefits What we offer The European business is yours to build: the pipeline, the number, the plan. title: Bereichsleiter Produktion & Technik (m/w/d) mit Perspektive Geschäftsführung
description: Manche Karriereschritte sind größer als ein neuer Job. Diese Position ist einer davon. Unser Mandant sucht eine Persönlichkeit, die heute bereits Verantwortung in einem produzierenden Unternehmen trägt – und sich vorstellen kann, morgen Verantwortung für ein ganzes Unternehmen zu übernehmen. Für Menschen. Für Technik. Für Produktivität. Und perspektivisch für das gesamte Unternehmen. Der Erfolgsbetrieb st ein wirtschaftlich gesundes, inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen mit jahrzehntelanger Tradition im Maschinen- und Fahrzeugbau. Mit rund 65 Mitarbeitern entwickelt und produziert das Unternehmen hochwertige Lösungen in den Bereichen Maschinenbau, Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau. Die Auftragslage ist solide, das Unternehmen arbeitet vollständig eigenfinanziert und verfügt über eine starke Marktposition. Im Zuge des anstehenden Generationenübergangs suchen wir nun eine technisch versierte und unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die zunächst operative Verantwortung insbesondere für die Bereiche Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau übernimmt. Und ausdrücklich gilt: Diese Aufgabe darf mehr werden. Bei entsprechender persönlicher und fachlicher Entwicklung besteht die klare Perspektive, sukzessive zusätzliche unternehmerische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich bis in die Geschäftsführung des Unternehmens hineinzuentwickeln. Aufgaben Sie möchten nicht den nächsten Titel auf Ihrer Visitenkarte, sondern tatsächlich mehr Verantwortung? Dann könnte diese Aufgabe der richtige nächste Schritt sein. Im Mittelpunkt Ihrer Tätigkeit stehen zunächst die Bereiche Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau. Hier übernehmen Sie wesentliche Teile der heutigen operativen Verantwortung eines geschäftsführenden Gesellschafters und entwickeln Produktion, Abläufe und Produkte gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Team weiter. Dabei ist der Schwerpunkt ganz bewusst auf das operative Geschäft gelegt: Rund 70 % Ihrer Aufgabe liegen in Produktion, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Qualität, Produktivität und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der betrieblichen Abläufe. Rund 30 % entfallen auf technische Fragestellungen, Konstruktion, Entwicklung und die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte. Sie müssen also nicht derjenige sein, der jedes Bauteil selbst konstruiert. Aber Sie sollten Technik verstehen, Produktion mögen – und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam mit den Mitarbeitern dafür zu sorgen, dass der Laden läuft. Und möglichst jeden Tag ein bisschen besser. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere: operative Verantwortung für die Bereiche Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Produktion und Arbeitsvorbereitung kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Produktivität, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Produktions- und Organisationsprozesse Begleitung technischer Weiterentwicklungen und konstruktiver Fragestellungen Aufnahme von Impulsen aus Vertrieb, Markt und Kundenanforderungen und Überführung in praktikable technische und operative Lösungen enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Einkauf und den übrigen Unternehmensbereichen Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Ihnen zugeordneten Mitarbeiter und Führungskräfte schrittweise Übernahme weitergehender unternehmerischer und kaufmännischer Verantwortung enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gesellschaftern sowie der bestehenden technischen Führung im Maschinenbau Der Geschäftsbereich Maschinenbau ist bereits heute technisch sehr gut aufgestellt und entsprechend verantwortet. Ihr operativer Schwerpunkt liegt daher ausdrücklich auf Containerbau sowie Bauwagen- und Fahrzeugbau. Qualifikation Wir suchen für diese Position ausdrücklich nicht zwingend den fertigen Geschäftsführer. Viel spannender kann für uns die Persönlichkeit sein, die heute beispielsweise als Produktionsleiter, Betriebsleiter, Werksleiter oder technischer Leiter erfolgreich arbeitet und sich inzwischen die Frage stellt: War das schon alles – oder bin ich bereit, unternehmerisch noch einen Schritt weiterzugehen? Idealerweise verfügen Sie über: eine technische Ausbildung bzw. ein technisches Studium, beispielsweise im Maschinenbau, Fahrzeugbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld mehrjährige Erfahrung in einem produzierenden mittelständischen Unternehmen Führungserfahrung in Produktion, Technik, Betriebs- oder Werksleitung ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Qualität und Produktivität technisches Verständnis in Bereichen wie Mechanik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und/oder Elektrik Erfahrung im Maschinen-, Fahrzeug-, Anlagen- oder Sondermaschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren industriellen Umfeld Freude daran, nicht nur zu analysieren, sondern Dinge tatsächlich umzusetzen unternehmerisches Denken und Interesse daran, sich perspektivisch auch mit kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragestellungen auseinanderzusetzen einen bodenständigen, verbindlichen und wertschätzenden Führungsstil Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Sie heute bereits alle Facetten einer Geschäftsführungsposition beherrschen. Entscheidend ist, dass Sie das Potenzial und vor allem den Willen mitbringen, dort hinzuwachsen. Benefits Vielleicht sind Sie heute Produktionsleiter und fragen sich, wann Ihnen endlich jemand zutraut, einen ganzen Betrieb zu führen. Vielleicht sind Sie Betriebsleiter und stellen fest, dass oberhalb Ihrer heutigen Position kaum noch Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bestehen. Oder Sie haben technisch und operativ bereits viel erreicht – und möchten nun lernen, ein Unternehmen zunehmend auch aus kaufmännischer und unternehmerischer Perspektive zu führen. Genau dafür kann diese Position eine außergewöhnliche Chance sein. Sie steigen nicht in ein sanierungsbedürftiges Unternehmen ein. Sie kommen in einen wirtschaftlich gesunden, eigenfinanzierten Familienbetrieb mit etablierten Produkten, erfahrenen Mitarbeitern und einer langfristigen Perspektive. Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit, zunächst dort Verantwortung zu übernehmen, wo Ihre heutige Stärke liegt: in Technik und Produktion. Gemeinsam mit den Gesellschaftern können Sie anschließend Schritt für Schritt zusätzliche Verantwortung übernehmen – kaufmännisch, strategisch und unternehmerisch. Mit der klaren Perspektive Geschäftsführung. Es erwartet Sie: eine langfristige Perspektive in einem erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen eine verantwortungsvolle operative Führungsaufgabe vom ersten Tag an ein klar definierter Schwerpunkt in Produktion und Technik kurze Entscheidungswege und unmittelbare Zusammenarbeit mit den Gesellschaftern viel Raum für eigene Ideen und Verbesserungen die Möglichkeit, sich gezielt in kaufmännische und unternehmerische Themen weiterzuentwickeln eine echte Entwicklungsperspektive bis in die Geschäftsführung eine attraktive, der Verantwortung und Ihrem Erfahrungsstand entsprechende Vergütung Dienstwagen sowie weitere marktübliche Nebenleistungen Haben Sie Lust auf ein solch spannendes Arbeitsumfeld? title: Content Operations QA Analyst
description: 🏆 What's the opportunity? cargo.one is the AI-native operating system for air and ocean freight. Logistics still runs on manual work, disconnected tools and messy data. Since 2018 we've been building the data foundation, and the AI agents on top of it, that let freight teams quote, book and manage rates in a fraction of the time. Today more than 30,000 users across 172 countries run on us. Ocean is our newest frontier. We've just brought ocean freight onto the platform alongside air, in one workspace powered by the same AI, and we need people who can make that ocean data rock solid from day one. As our Content Operations QA Analyst (Ocean) , you're the sharp eye that keeps this data trustworthy. Freight forwarders send us detailed rate sheets, and increasingly our AI helps process them. You'll compare the processed data with the source documents, correct discrepancies and make sure every figure is right before a customer sees it. You'll build a strong understanding of ocean rates and surcharges so you can spot what doesn't add up. Content is the foundation much of our product rests on. This data powers the quoting of freight solutions by our customers to their own customers, the shippers: a forwarder wins that business on the rates we serve. We're backed by leading investors, including Index, Bessemer, Point Nine, Creandum and Lufthansa, and we work remote-first in a positive, feedback-driven and genuinely fun team. 🌍 Where you can work We're remote-first. You can work from (almost) anywhere cargo.one is able to employ through our partner Remote . We're a remote company, but we regularly meet in person, too. 🎬 A snapshot of what you'll be doing here Quality-check the ocean freight contracts, rates and surcharges that our partners and AI populate, cross-checking every entry against the source rate sheets and tariffs. Work through a steady queue of contracts with care. Follow the QA steps and record what you checked. Learn how ocean rates and surcharges work so you can spot when something looks wrong. Catch and correct errors before they reach our customers, keeping our data accurate and trustworthy. Communicate clearly with our vendor partners when something needs fixing, and close the loop so the same mistake doesn't recur. Spot recurring error patterns and help improve our QA checks, guides and documentation. Use AI tools to make the QA process faster and sharper, and ideally help build them. Maintain structured, high-quality master data across the ocean content set. 🙋 We're looking for someone who has Exceptional attention to detail. It's the heart of the role. The focus to work through detailed information without losing accuracy. Fluent written and spoken English, since you'll work with international vendor partners every day. The drive to work independently and own your cases once you're up to speed. Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, and a genuine love of working with structured data. Comfort working in high-volume, structured workflows where accuracy really matters. Hands-on experience using AI tools to get work done, even better if you've built something with them. Bonus: experience in ocean or air freight, logistics or shipping (e.g. freight forwarder, NVOCC, carrier ops). ❤️ We think you'll love working here if You value building great relationships and trust with your team and manager. You take real satisfaction in catching the small details that others miss. You see working remotely successfully as a pioneering challenge that's constantly evolving. In everything you do, you take ownership and get a kick out of exceeding expectations. You love experimenting with new ideas and get excited when you find an opportunity to improve a process. Faced with a choice, you'd rather take the ambitious option and grow than the easy one. You see the value of giving and receiving feedback, and build it into everything you do. You're not afraid to voice your opinions, and you like backing them up with data. ✨ Benefits Home-office budget of €650 for a desk, chair, monitor and the rest. Whole company Offsites. Co-working options worldwide through our partner Desana. 24 paid vacation days on top of your local bank holidays, plus special leave. 📚 Curious to know more? title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description: What we do At Briink , we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials. Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide. We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good. Application requirement: Intro video As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering: Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you. Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;) Your role As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer , you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals. This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket. You will: Own product features end to end , from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement. Design and build scalable backend systems , including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products. Build and ship applied AI/LLM features , such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation. Improve the robustness of our systems , strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale. Work directly with users, product, and data , using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works. Prototype and test new AI capabilities , turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap. Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge , helping the team make better product and technical decisions. Collaborate closely with other engineers , including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving. Your profile Technical requirements Strong professional backend engineering experience , with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems. Experience in a small, high-ownership product team , ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers. Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end , rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation. Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly). Strong API, database, and systems design skills , with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products. Applied AI/LLM experience : you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems. A solid software-quality mindset , including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security. Cloud and container experience , with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads. Fluent English (C1+) , both written and spoken. Nice to have Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products . Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems . Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads. Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting . German language skills. Who you are Kind and collaborative : You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment. Mission-driven : You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action. Sharp and curious : You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems. A product-minded builder : You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value. Highly self-directed : You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight. Pragmatic and action-oriented : You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements. Opinionated but open-minded : You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others. Commercially aware and creative : You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed. If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection! What we offer Competitive salary and equity , reflecting your impact and ownership. Purpose-driven mission : Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent. Flexible hybrid setup : Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus. Trust and autonomy : Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows. A genuinely high-impact role : Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation. Dynamic environment : Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability. Learning budget and quarterly hackathons : Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward. A thoughtful hiring process : We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: What's it all about? The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.
