title: Senior Creative Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Senior Creative Strategist&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <p>The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.</p> <p>Success in this role looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK &amp; DE/FR markets</li> <li>Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity</li> <li>Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK &amp; DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams</li> <li>Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence</li> <li>Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK &amp; DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams</li> <li>Leveraging data to inform strategic direction</li> <li>This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.</li> </ul> <p>This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2663" data-local-id="e0c03b8d-8a8f-42ae-b3e9-26b5a2308ae6"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Responsibilities</span></strong></p> <p><em>Creative Adaptation &amp; Briefing</em></p> <ul> <li>Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK &amp; DE/FR adaptation</li> <li>Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK &amp; DE/FR audiences</li> <li>Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required</li> <li>Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK &amp; DE/FR market context embedded</li> <li>Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally</li> <li>Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership</li> </ul> <p><em>Experimentation &amp; Performance</em></p> <ul> <li>Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK &amp; DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting</li> <li>Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance</li> <li>Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations</li> <li>Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK &amp; DE/FR markets to inform creative direction</li> <li>Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks</li> </ul> <p><em>Cross-functional Collaboration</em></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams</li> <li>Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning</li> <li>Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2753" data-local-id="9ae6a13b-2175-4a37-a4c2-5839b2f592ae"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Qualifications</span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2769" data-local-id="46937c2f-d543-4fbd-b76c-3593c6541fb4"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Required:&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree required</li> <li>5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience</li> <li>Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences</li> <li>Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats</li> <li>Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results</li> <li>Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously</li> <li>Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)</li> <li>Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment</li> <li>Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3083" data-local-id="dbaae2d5-3e8d-43bb-be8c-e1c7e3b63382"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Preferred:&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms</li> <li>Experience briefing and working with UGC creators</li> <li>Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3150"><em><span style="font-size: 11px;">All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. </span></em><em><span style="font-size: 11px;">Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.</span></em></p></div><div class="title">Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€64.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€74.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3352">Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. title: Senior Associate (European Competition practice) - m/f/d
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.crai.com">Charles River Associates</a> is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.</p> <p>CRA's <a href="https://www.crai.com/services/antitrust-and-competition/ecp/">European Competition practice</a> specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: &nbsp;firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. &nbsp;We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.</p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>The Senior Associate position is the entry-level position for applicants with a PhD in Economics and limited work experience. The Senior Associate position is also open to applicants with a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority. Candidates will be expected to rapidly take on genuine responsibility, working closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practical input to projects. A Senior Associate would typically:</p> <ul> <li>&nbsp;Conduct analyses and collect evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations</li> <li>&nbsp;Perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring the use of cloud computing</li> <li>&nbsp;Build economic models tailored to the issues at hand and supporting our expert opinions and business recommendations</li> <li>&nbsp;Contribute to the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers</li> <li>&nbsp;Interact with clients and communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to non-experts in an understandable, accessible manner</li> <li>&nbsp;Manage and mentor junior staff</li> <li>Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions</li> <li>Participate in practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>PhD in economics from a well-regarded institution with a strong foundation in microeconomics, preferably with a specialisation in industrial economics and/or econometrics; non-PhD applicants should have a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority</li> <li>Fluency in English, other language skills are considered an asset</li> <li>High degree of numeracy, ability to analyse data, familiarity with econometric techniques</li> <li>Exceptional written and oral communication skills</li> <li>Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities</li> <li>Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills</li> <li>Clear and demonstrated interest in economic consulting through coursework, work experience, or activities<strong><br></strong></li> </ul> <h4>To Apply</h4> <p>Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Curriculum Vitae</strong> – please include current address, email and telephone number;</li> <li><strong>Covering letter</strong> – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Germany and how this role matches your goals;</li> <li><strong>Writing Sample (optional)</strong> – we prefer a sole-authored submission from an existing work (work product, published article or job market paper) that includes your commentary on a quantitative analysis and/or relevant to the field of economics;</li> <li><strong>Transcripts (optional) </strong>- from the most recent academic training (may be unofficial copies).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Location Flexibility</strong></p> <p>CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.</p> <h4>Our Commitment to Diversity</h4> <p>Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.</p> <p><em>The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
description: Your Mission EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. What you will do Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform. Agree on definitions , data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them. Maintain and verify the certified data layer , built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it. Use SQL to validate data , investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources. Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning. Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree. Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation. Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully. What this role is not You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. What you bring along Must-have Senior experience in BI , analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful. Strong SQL skills .You can read and write SQL ,validate data, and trace where a number comes from. Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners. Experience with data models , data quality , or data governance. A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations. Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers. A hands-on , business-minded approach . You connect business questions with practical data solutions. Experience with automation , AI Agents , or AI-supported workflows . Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus. Nice to have Experience with Metabase , dbt , AWS Glue , Spark , Airbyte , or comparable tools. Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes. Experience in B2B SaaS , EV charging , energy , mobility, or a related field. You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL , sound data thinking , and the ability to bring people to one shared definition . What you can expect from us How we work Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable. Where you will work Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. What you get 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest. Mental health , taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive. AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down. Move sustainably - JobRad , subsidised public transport , or EGYM Wellpass . You choose what fits your life. €1,000 learning budget -Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow. Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO . Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fineprint. title: Senior Legal Counsel (Regulatory and Data Privacy)
description: <p>You’re a privacy expert who knows how to navigate global regulations without slowing down innovation.<strong> </strong>You thrive on translating dense legal frameworks into practical guidance for technical teams. If you want to build scalable data protection strategies that actually make sense, this is for you.</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As data privacy and AI regulations rapidly evolve, ensuring our tools and operations remain compliant is more critical than ever. <strong>In this role, you’ll take ownership of our privacy-by-design initiatives, shaping how we handle data across our international operations.</strong> You will influence how product features are built and how cross-border data transfers are structured, ensuring we meet regulatory standards without adding unnecessary friction. Working closely with engineering, AI, security, and HR teams, you’ll turn legal requirements into actionable advice. As Senior Legal Counsel on our Regulatory and Data Privacy team, you’ll be instrumental in modernizing our compliance frameworks and finding ways to use automation to make our legal processes smarter and more predictable.</p> <h2>Day to day, you will:</h2> <ul> <li>Advise cross-functional groups (including AI, security, HR, and engineering) on data privacy and regulatory compliance.</li> <li>Evaluate product features, global data governance, and cross-border transfer mechanisms (like DPAs and SCCs) for privacy-by-design compliance.</li> <li>Draft, review, and maintain internal and external data protection agreements, privacy policies, and terms of service.</li> <li>Map our data flows and technical operations to ensure they fit within a coherent global regulatory framework.</li> <li>Research international regulatory shifts and prepare clear, structured legal memos and comparative analyses.</li> <li>Build and improve legal templates, guidance, DSAR processes, and knowledge databases.</li> <li>Spot and assess legal risks related to new technology laws, technical product design, and data processing.</li> <li>Drive process improvements within the team to boost efficiency, incorporating AI and automation tools where appropriate.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A high degree of adaptability when dealing with novel technical concepts and title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
description: About us UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies. Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha. At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way. Your mission You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions. Your profile You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university. You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro). You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals. You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop. You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it. You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required. How we work We are an AI-powered development team . Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write. Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you. Potential Research Directions These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads. 1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot. 2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data. 3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several. Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own. What we offer Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors. Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events. Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship. Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions. Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on. AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly. Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively. Interested? Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you! Diversity is important to us Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability. Contact Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany www.uvcpartners.com UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer. UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM. title: Senior Partnership Manager - DE (f/m/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our team and culture make us unique — we’re driven by impact and growth, where every one of us strives to learn and excel. Recognised by Sifted’s Rising 100 and LinkedIn's Top Startups , we’re here to help propel your career and together, make Moss a lasting success. Join our Partnerships team as a Partnerships Manager (f/m/d) . You will play a pivotal role in cultivating long-term relationships with partners and in expanding the channels through which we excite our potential customers for Moss. Through the cross-functional collaboration with internal stakeholders and leveraging your expertise, you will be a key pillar in Moss’ journey to become the European market leader in spend management. Your responsibilities Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day: Partner Identification & Assessment - Identify potential partnership opportunities that align with Moss' strategic goals and target markets. Conduct thorough assessments to evaluate the suitability and potential value of prospective partners. Relationship Building - Cultivate and nurture relationships with existing and potential partners. Establish rapport, engage in effective communication, and maintain regular contact to foster strong, mutually beneficial partnerships. Negotiation & Agreement - Lead negotiations with partners to create and finalize agreements, ensuring that commercial terms are beneficial. Collaborate closely with legal and executive teams to ensure contract compliance and risk mitigation. Revenue Generation - Develop and implement strategies to drive revenue growth through partnerships. This may include joint marketing campaigns, co-selling initiatives, and referral programs. Continuously monitor and optimize partnership performance to maximize financial outcomes. Cross-functional Collaboration - Collaborate with various internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Support to align partnership activities with Moss' overall business goals. Ensure seamless coordination and communication across departments to execute partnership initiatives effectively. About you We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in this role: Proven experience in B2B partnership roles or business development in a fast-growing SaaS or financial services company Fluent in German (C2) & English (C1) In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Trusted partner: you quickly establish strong credibility with partners, identifying synergies to build lasting relationships. Entrepreneurial Mindset: you are always on the lookout for new partnerships, ready to generate high impact for Moss. You approach lead generation in an efficient and pragmatic way, understanding partners' processes and leveraging insights for joint revenue opportunities. Ownership: you fully own your tasks, your constant learning progress and partner relationships, proactively overcoming obstacles and ensuring success aligned with broader business goals. Collaborative Spirit: you proactively collaborate within your team, and with internal and external stakeholders to create a best-in-class partner and customer experience. Resilient: you bounce back swiftly and independently of challenges, setbacks, or complex situations, displaying a willingness to learn and improve strategies for working with partners and within Moss. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 5,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, Gusto and Auto1, Moss has raised €200+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. Moss is backed by the most renowned tech investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star and Portage. We have a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities in 5 offices across Europe. Be part of a culture that thrives on impact and speed, where you can take bold moves, learn fast and accomplish more. We’re a place where you can fast track your career - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package). By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy . Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive - Mid-market
description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses. AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it. We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture. Check out our principles to see how we work. Your mission You will be pivotal for telli's growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and closing deals. As our first experienced enterprise sales hire, you'll help us 10x telli from the ground up. what you'll do: Own large enterprise deals end-to-end: Discovery, demos, security review, procurement, contract redlines, you carry the deal from the first call through signature uncovering telli’s value for the customer Generate the your own pipeline: Our BDR team supports you; they don't replace you. You target the accounts, you write the outbound, you make the calls Multi-thread complex buying committees: Heads of Sales, Operations, CX, Legal, IT, Security, Procurement, and CFOs at companies of 500 to 10,000+ employees. You build the relationships before procurement comes in to test them Own a quota and hit revenue targets: Close large deals that meaningfully contribute to telli’s growth Shape telli's enterprise playbook: qualification, multi-thread strategy, executive engagement, pricing. What works for you becomes the team standard Feed structured signal back into product, marketing, and strategy: You sit closest to the customer. Your input shapes what we build next what makes you a great fit: You have at least 1 year of experience closing mid-market deals: you’ve sold mid-five-figure contracts and consistently performed at the top of your team. You're an elite relationship builder: you know the difference between a contact and a champion, and you've won deals because of that distinction. description: HEAD OF SALES (m/w/d) Berlin, Deutschland · Vollzeit · Vor Ort Über uns Wir von Global Talent Co. verbinden Top-Talente mit den innovativsten Technologieunternehmen weltweit. Für diese Position arbeiten wir in direkter Partnerschaft mit unserem Kunden zusammen, um eine der wichtigsten Positionen für dessen Wachstumskurs zu besetzen. Über das Unternehmen Ein schnell wachsendes, gründergeführtes B2B-Signage-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin steht an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt: dem nächsten großen Sprung. Gegründet 2014, hat sich das Unternehmen als Premium-Marke etabliert, der namhafte Kunden aus Retail, Hospitality, Tech und Luxus in Deutschland, Schweden, Polen und darüber hinaus vertrauen. Die Branche war jahrzehntelang fragmentiert und handwerklich geprägt. Genau das verändert dieses Unternehmen gerade grundlegend, durch smarte Prozesse, Technologie und KI. Das ist kein Startup bei null. Es ist ein profitables, wachsendes Geschäft mit echten Kunden und einem klaren Kurs zur europäischen Marktführerschaft. Mit Standorten in Berlin, Wrocław und Helsingborg baut das Unternehmen jetzt das Führungsteam auf, das diesen Sprung möglich macht. Die Rolle Das ist eine der wichtigsten Einstellungen des Jahres für dieses Unternehmen. Gesucht wird jemand mit Vision, der Verantwortung übernimmt und nicht nur verwaltet, sondern gestaltet. title: Sales Director (German-speaking)
description: Sales Director (German-speaking) Berlin, Germany · Full-time · On-site ABOUT US At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded professionals. What makes this company unique is its ambition: to become the first truly scalable business in a sector that has historically been fragmented, craft-based, and impossible to systematise. As Sales Director you'll architect the commercial engine. You'll own the inbound and outbound sales functions, the CRM and AI-driven workflow transformation, and the customer experience from first touch to retention. You'll manage and develop a growing team of sales consultants, working closely with the founders to shape strategy and execute with discipline. title: PR Manager (m/f/d)
description: About Yepoda Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients. Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe – online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day. As PR Manager, you will lead Yepoda’s global communications and PR strategy across all markets. Your focus is to elevate brand awareness, ensure consistent messaging, and create impactful stories across media, partners, and internal channels, while driving measurable reach, impressions, and brand impact in every market. Your Tasks Lead and continuously evolve Yepoda’s global PR strategy, messaging, and brand storytelling across all markets and channels. Own PR performance across markets by defining, tracking, and achieving clear KPIs on impressions, reach, and share of voice. Manage and steer international PR agencies, including briefing, performance management, budget control, and negotiation of retainers and fees. Plan, draft, and coordinate press releases, media kits, seeding concepts, PR boxes, and PR activations; track and report on results. Drive PR box concepts and storytelling in close collaboration with the Creative and Influencer Marketing teams. Build and maintain key company facts, press materials, and ensure all press touchpoints remain updated and aligned. Develop communication strategies for sustainability, Pride, giving-back initiatives, and other brand purpose campaigns. Ensure consistent brand tone, messaging, and visual alignment across PR, influencer collaborations, social media, packaging, and retail touchpoints. Collaborate closely with the Trade Marketing Manager on B2B-related PR activities, including retailer partnerships such as Sephora. Your Profile Several years of experience in PR, communications, or brand marketing, ideally within beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands. Strong experience working with and managing international PR agencies across multiple markets. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence writing press-ready content. Comfortable owning PR strategy end-to-end and translating it into measurable brand impact. Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects in parallel. Collaborative, calm, and adaptable in a fast-moving scale-up environment. Fluent in English; additional European languages (e.g. German, French, Spanish, or Italian) are highly desirable. Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand. Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery. title: UA Manager
description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. At Almedia, you’ll: Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast. Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity. Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people. Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need. UA Manager Salary range: €65,000-80,000/annum We're looking for a UA Manager to take ownership of our core app user acquisition channels. This is a high-stakes, hands-on role built for someone who lives in the data, moves fast on optimizations, and knows how to scale app campaigns across AppLovin, Facebook, and TikTok. You'll be managing significant budgets across live campaigns — this is not a planning role. It requires daily attention, sharp instincts, and the ability to diagnose and fix performance problems in real time. What You'll Do 🎯 Own App UA at Scale: Take ownership of app install campaigns across AppLovin, Google UAC, Facebook, TikTok, and DSPs - managing $500k+ in daily spend and optimizing toward revenue and predictive LTV targets. Drive Daily Performance: Monitor live campaigns daily, make proactive budget and bid adjustments, and troubleshoot performance drops without waiting to be asked. Lead Creative Strategy: Analyze top-performing creatives and competitive trends, identify what's working on TikTok and Facebook, and plan a balanced production mix of iterations and new concepts. Manage a Creative Ecosystem: Coordinate with our internal creative team - briefing, reviewing, and prioritizing production to keep testing pipelines moving. Navigate Attribution Complexity: Work across multiple campaign types, manage cross-channel attribution windows and settings, and use Adjust MMP to ensure clean app tracking and accurate performance reads. Build Toward LTV: Set and optimize against primary KPIs rooted in revenue and predictive lifetime value - understanding not just surface metrics but the downstream signals that predict real business impact. What You'll Bring 💡 App UA Track Record: Proven experience scaling app install campaigns across at least two of: AppLovin, Unity, Snapchat, Facebook, TikTok, or programmatic DSPs - with meaningful budget responsibility. Spend-Scale Comfort: You've managed large daily budgets in a live environment and know how to operate with both precision and speed when campaigns are actively running. Creative Judgment: You can analyze performance data to identify what creative is working, brief agencies effectively, and plan a testing roadmap that balances iteration with new concepts. Attribution Fluency: Solid understanding of mobile attribution, MMP setup (Adjust preferred), and how different campaign types and attribution windows interact — especially across app and web. LTV & Revenue Focus: Experience optimizing toward revenue-based KPIs and predictive LTV, ideally in gaming or subscription apps. If you don't have gaming background, you need to clearly demonstrate you understand the metrics that drive performance downstream. Problem-Solving Operator: You diagnose, you act, you iterate. You don't wait for weekly reviews to catch a problem — you're in the account daily and you fix things before they become fires. What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟 You treat a live campaign like it's always your responsibility - proactive, not reactive. You think in signals and ratios, not just top-line spend. You're a confident stakeholder manager who can align internal teams and external agencies toward a shared creative and performance roadmap. You're comfortable with complexity - multiple campaign types, channels, and attribution layers - and you build clarity from it rather than getting slowed down by it. Why Almedia? 🎁 Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success. Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one. Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin. Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more. We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. title: On Holiday Support Agent
description: Why loveholidays? At loveholidays - we trailblaze together . We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away. Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation . Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays. You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe , you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together. About the team: The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday. Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution. You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays.. Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered. The impact you’ll have: You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement. This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams. Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets. High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding. Your day-to-day: Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments Your skillset: Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills A calm, empathetic and professional communication style Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines Excellent written and verbal communication skills Strong problem-solving and investigative skills Excellent organisation and attention to detail Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures The interview journey: Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes Perks of joining us: Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits: Company pension contributions at 5% Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum Enhanced maternity/paternity leave Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey. title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading. These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges. The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted. What You'll Own Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery. Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability. Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience. Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing. Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling. Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners. Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements. What We're Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production. Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems. Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs. Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain. Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints. Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used. Nice to have Engineering or highly technical product background. Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products. Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products. Outcome Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction Location This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading. These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges. The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted. What You'll Own Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery. Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability. Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience. Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing. Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling. Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners. Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements. What We're Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production. Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems. Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs. Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain. Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints. Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used. Nice to have Engineering or highly technical product background. Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products. Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products. Outcome Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction Location This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
